CIVIL TRIALS —— LOCATION. Notwithstanding any 5 provision to the contrary, for the fiscal year beginning July 6 1, 2026, and ending June 30, 2027, if all parties in a case 7 agree, a civil trial including a jury trial may take place in a 8 county contiguous to the county with proper jurisdiction, even 9 if the contiguous county is located in an adjacent judicial 10 district or judicial election district. If the trial is moved 11 pursuant to this section, court personnel shall treat the case 12 as if a change of venue occurred. 13 Sec. 3. TRAVEL REIMBURSEMENT. Notwithstanding section 14 602.1509 , for the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2026, and 15 ending June 30, 2027, a judicial officer may waive travel 16 reimbursement for any travel outside the judicial officer’s 17 county of residence to conduct official judicial business. 18 Sec. 4. JUDICIAL OFFICER —— UNPAID LEAVE. Notwithstanding 19 the annual salary rates for judicial officers established by 20 2025 Iowa Acts, chapter 158, section 6, for the fiscal year 21 beginning July 1, 2026, and ending June 30, 2027, the supreme 22 court may by order place all judicial officers on unpaid leave 23 status on any day employees of the judicial branch are placed 24 on temporary layoff status. The biweekly pay of the judicial 25 officers shall be reduced accordingly for the pay period in 26 which the unpaid leave date occurred in the same manner as 27 for noncontract employees of the judicial branch. Through 28 the course of the fiscal year, the judicial branch may use an 29 amount equal to the aggregate amount of salary reductions due 30 to the judicial officer unpaid leave days for any purpose other 31 than for judicial salaries. 32 Sec. 5.
